API Reference#

The public surface of fastapi_uploadstream consists of two user-facing objects (fastapi_uploadstream.StreamBody() and fastapi_uploadstream.UploadStream) and one OpenAPI helper (fastapi_uploadstream.install_uploadstream_openapi()).

.. py:class:: UploadStream(request, receiver, cancel_receive)

module:

fastapi_uploadstream

A streaming view of a raw request body.

This object intentionally mimics only the subset of UploadFile behavior that is meaningful for one-pass, non-multipart request streaming.

.. py:method:: UploadStream.read(size=-1)

module:

fastapi_uploadstream

async:
Read bytes from the streamed request body.

.. py:method:: UploadStream.seek(offset) :module: fastapi_uploadstream :async:

Advance the stream by consuming and discarding bytes.

:param offset: Number of bytes to advance. Must be non-negative.

:raises ValueError: If offset is negative.

.. py:method:: UploadStream.iter_chunks(chunk_size=65536) :module: fastapi_uploadstream :async:

Yield the request body in chunks of specified size.

:param chunk_size: Size of each chunk in bytes. Defaults to 64KB. Must be positive.

:Yields: Chunks of bytes until EOF.

:raises ValueError: If chunk_size is not positive.

.. py:method:: UploadStream.close() :module: fastapi_uploadstream :async:

Stop background request pumping and close the receive stream.
